title: Forge version output
description: The JSON object emitted by `forge version --format json`. Frozen by WBS 6.4.2. Any breaking change to field names requires an ADR.

version.description: Semantic version of the build, or the empty string for an uninstrumented build. Not validated as semver; the build system is responsible for the format.

commit.description: Short git SHA of the built commit, or the empty string when built outside a git working tree.

build_date.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the build, or the empty string for an uninstrumented build. Not validated as a timestamp by the schema; the build system is responsible for the format.

dirty.description: True if the build was produced from a working tree with uncommitted changes; false otherwise.
